units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 12a:13">B. Bath. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>אטו חכם לאו נ׳ וכ׳</he> was a scholar never a prophet? <cite ref="Bava Batra 12a:14">Ib.</cite> <he>חכם עדיף מנ׳</he> a scholar is superior to a prophet.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:12">Sot. IX, 12</cite> <he>נ׳ הראשונים</he> the early prophets (of the first Temple).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1:3">Lev. R. s. 1</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="B00753"><he>בַּיִת</he></cite>.

Pes. 66ᵃ אם אין נ׳ הן בני נ׳ הן if they (the Israelites) are no prophets, yet they are sons of prophets (they will find what is right intuitively); Y. Sabb. XIX, 17ᵃ top. Lev. R. l. c.; Gen. R. s. 74 נְבִיאֵי ישראל Israelitish prophets; נ׳ אומות העולם heathen prophets; a. v. fr.—נָבִיא (sub. ספר) נְבִיאִים (sub. ספרי) N’biim, Prophets, the second division of the Scriptures. Tosef. Meg. IV (III), 18 אין מפטירין בנביא וכ׳ we read in the Prophets for the Haftarah no more than three verses at a time (to be interpreted).
<cite ref="Megillah 21b:1">Meg. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>ובנביא אחד וכ׳</he> and when reading from the Prophets (for the Haftarah), one reads and two may interpret.
<cite ref="Megillah 27a:10">Ib. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>מניחין … על גבי נביאים וכתובים</he> you may put … parts of the Pentateuch on the Prophets or the Hagiographa, but not the Prophets &c.
B. Bath. 14ᵇ סדרן של נ׳ the order of the books of Prophets; a. fr.—Fem. נְבִיאָה.
Pes. 9ᵇ וכי חולדה נ׳ וכ׳ is the weasel (ḥuldah) a prophetess to know &c.? Deut. R. s. 6; a. fr.—Pl. נְבִיאוֹת.
